# Rathinam Crackers

> PESO-licensed online cracker shop based in Sivakasi, Tamil Nadu, India.
> We sell family fireworks, gift boxes and bulk orders for weddings and
> festivals, shipped pan-India with proper GST invoices.

## About
- Location: Sivakasi, Tamil Nadu, India — the fireworks capital of India.
- Licence: PESO (Petroleum and Explosives Safety Organisation) compliant.
- Ships to: All Indian states where fireworks delivery is legally permitted.
- Payments: Cash on delivery and bank transfer.
- Invoices: Full GST invoices (CGST + SGST intra-state, IGST inter-state).

## What we sell
- Sparklers, ground chakkars, flower pots, sky shots, aerial cakes,
  rockets, novelty crackers, kids' fireworks, and curated gift boxes.
- In-house brand "Rathinam" plus selected partner brands hand-crafted
  in Sivakasi.

## How to order
1. Browse the catalogue at /website/catalogue
2. Pick variants and quantities, add to cart
3. Checkout with name, phone and shipping address — guest checkout, no
   account required
4. We confirm the order by phone within 24 hours

## Bulk / wedding orders
- 10+ units of the same item automatically get the wholesale rate.
- Very large orders: please call us first.
